# SampleHost subscription plans

Example data for development. These are not real plans or real prices.

## plan: samplehost-assistant-monthly
- provider: SampleHost
- name: Assistant Monthly
- price: 20.00 EUR
- billing_interval: monthly
- min_seats: 1
- regions: DE, FR, NL
- max_context: 32768
- messages_per_day: 200
- supports_api: no
- commercial_use: yes
- suitable_for: coding, writing, studying, document_analysis
